description: Massachusetts HEAP helps eligible residents pay part of their winter heating costs. Apply through the local energy agency or the Commonwealth’s HEAP portal.
introduction: Massachusetts HEAP helps eligible residents pay part of their winter heating costs. Apply through the local energy agency or the Commonwealth’s HEAP portal.

who: Massachusetts households responsible for heating costs, including heat included in rent.
Household size and gross annual income determine eligibility; the published ceiling is 60% of state median income.
sections.get: A contribution toward winter heating expenses. Ask the agency about separate weatherization, heating repair and utility discount programs.
sections.docs: Prepare recent income records, household names, address, heating supplier account and lease if heat is included in rent. Ask the agency for its exact checklist before sending documents.
sections.apply:
1. Open the state HEAP application page below and use its application and provider locator.
  2. Apply online, or contact the agency serving your town for a phone or in-person application.
  3. Tell the agency immediately about a shutoff notice or lack of fuel.
sections.after: Save the confirmation and provider’s contact information. Ask which heating season the application covers and whether additional proof is needed; keep communicating with the supplier while assistance is pending.
sections.sources:
• State HEAP application and locator
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Is heat included in rent covered?
You may apply; tell the agency that your rent includes heat.
The state describes HEAP as a free resource.
Does HEAP pay the whole bill?
It helps pay a portion of winter heating costs.
Where do I ask about the current season?
Ask the local administering agency serving your city or town.
Weatherization is a separate service; ask the agency to screen you for it.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
